title: Barricades and a standing ovation in Northern Ireland
summary: After passing four armed checkpoints, he plays to 700 students and faculty who sing He's a Jolly Good Fellow, reducing him to tears.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You said you went through four barricades--
People checking your credentials along the way--
With machine guns and not what--

And, as I said to you - I think it was yesterday, I said something happened to me there that has never happened before in my whole lifetime. When I finished the concert, they screamed and yelled for an encore which, of course, I did; there was about 700 from school kids on up to the faculty--- they were all in there and so I did another encore and I had a hell of a time getting back to my dressing room because it was so filled with people and on my way through the crowd they all stood up - I don't know whether they had this planned or whether they just somebody started it; they were all standing up applauding anyway - the whole audience and suddenly they went into - "he's a jolly good fellow---".
